reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x0047CAD0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/0047CAD0-DefineAmmoType.cpp at sha256 e1e83fdd7fdfe5e7b67b0c31249f573cb82c84167d27952fc94dc5192bf828f8 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineAmmoType(long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: DefineAmmoType

retail_function.summary: Single large block 0x47CAD0-0x47CE0x: Script_EvalArgInt/Script_GetArg over the ammo grammar, Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 for name/fields, TaskType_Set, Profile_ValueSet, writes the g_5C10E4*0x168 record at 0x005BE3E0 and returns 1.

candidate_function.summary: Single large block 0x47CAD0-0x47CE0x: Script_EvalArgInt/Script_GetArg over the ammo grammar, Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 for name/fields, TaskType_Set, Profile_ValueSet, writes the g_5C10E4*0x168 record at 0x005BE3E0 and returns 1.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x0047CAD0 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/define/0047CAD0-DefineAmmoType.cpp (sha256 e1e83fdd7fdfe5e7b67b0c31249f573cb82c84167d27952fc94dc5192bf828f8). Single large block 0x47CAD0-0x47CE0x: Script_EvalArgInt/Script_GetArg over the ammo grammar, Sys_ResolveSymbol_23 for name/fields, TaskType_Set, Profile_ValueSet, writes the g_5C10E4*0x168 record at 0x005BE3E0 and returns 1.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN records (long double arg1, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc): an x87 input, a stack word and the [E+0xc] frame. The candidate (long double context, int arg2, float arg3) puts the long double on the stack and shifts arg3 away from [E+0xc].

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: BN records (long double arg1, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc): an x87 input, a stack word and the [E+0xc] frame. The candidate (long double context, int arg2, float arg3) puts the long double on the stack and shifts arg3 away from [E+0xc].

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) at 0x0047CAD0; radare2 recovers the identical 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 19 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail's 17 calls include Sys_ResolveSymbol_23, TaskType_Set, Profile_ValueSet, Script_EvalArgInt and an indirect slot; the candidate keeps the names but passes a shifted frame value.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Record stride 0x168; buffer sizes 0x20/0x80/0x100; global 0x005C10E4; fields 0x005BE3E0..0x005BE538.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The record writes use the right 0x168 stride and the right field offsets, but the frame argument is not the retail [E+0xc] word, so the parsed values are read from the wrong stack slot.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Returns 1 — plausible but not the retail return word.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The x87 input is replaced by a stack long double; the fstp store of the parsed value is not reproduced at the correct stack position.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, int32_t arg2, float arg3 @ 0xc)" at 0x0047CAD0; radare2 recovers "fcn.0047cad0 (int32_t arg_a4h, int32_t arg_a8h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x0047CAD0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t DefineAmmoType(long param_1, int32_t param_2, float param_3);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
